memory: I believe that leadership in finance is about striking a delicate balance between fostering a culture of excellence and maintaining humanity. As the Managing Director of Legend Investments, I have the privilege of overseeing a talented team of 180 professionals across our investment, research, and operations divisions. My leadership philosophy is built on three core pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. By empowering our team members to take ownership of their work and providing them with the autonomy to make informed decisions, I believe we can unlock the full potential of each individual. Additionally, I emphasize the importance of accountability, ensuring that our team members are held to high standards and are responsible for their actions. Lastly, I believe that continuous growth is essential for staying ahead in the ever-changing landscape of finance. By investing in our team members' professional development and encouraging them to challenge conventional thinking, we can stay innovative and adapt to new opportunities. I'm proud to have an open-door policy, which allows even our most junior analysts to share their ideas and insights. This approach has led to some remarkable breakthroughs, such as the novel approach to ESG scoring proposed by a second-year analyst last month. At Legend Investments, I oversee a team of 180 professionals across our investment, research, and operations divisions. My leadership philosophy centers on three pillars: empowerment, accountability, and continuous growth. I've found that the best ideas often come from the most unexpected places, so I maintain an open-door policy and encourage even our most junior analysts to challenge conventional thinking. Every Monday, I host a 'strategic roundtable' where team members from all levels can present investment theses or operational improvements. Last month, a second-year analyst proposed a novel approach to ESG scoring that we're now implementing across our portfolio. Leadership isn't about having all the answers—it's about fostering an environment where great ideas can flourish.
